cases.name: known-good completion -> PASS
cases.incident: sanity: a correct self-contained program must score PASS

cases.name: known-bad completion -> FAIL
cases.incident: sanity: a wrong program must score FAIL (guards against a scorer that always passes)

cases.name: missing-prompt (non-self-contained) -> detected/FAIL
cases.incident: INCIDENT 2026-08-10 (81eed6d): storing the bare completion scored concise models 0/60 (NameError on prompt-provided helper). The fix prepends the prompt.

cases.name: wrong (unknown) task_id -> detected
cases.incident: a sample whose id is not in the dataset must be flagged, not scored

cases.name: duplicate task_id -> detected
cases.incident: two samples for one id would let one silently shadow the other

cases.name: missing sample -> detected
cases.incident: a subset missing an expected id would score a smaller-than-claimed denominator

cases.name: extra sample -> detected
cases.incident: an id outside the declared subset must be surfaced

cases.name: truncated generation -> detected
cases.incident: a generation that hit the token cap (finish_reason=length) must not be scored as a genuine wrong answer (cf. fable-fusion non-termination, LAB-CLOSE-002)

cases.name: malformed JSONL -> detected
cases.incident: a corrupt line must be reported, not silently skipped (which would shrink the subset)

cases.name: stale result cache -> invalidation forced
cases.incident: INCIDENT 2026-08-10 (81eed6d): EvalPlus reuses <padded>_eval_results.json if present, so re-scoring a corrected samples file returned STALE verdicts. bust_stale_results removes it.

cases.name: wrong benchmark version -> detected
cases.incident: a score recorded under a different benchmark version must not be compared as-is

cases.name: wrong dataset hash -> detected
cases.incident: an edited/swapped dataset changes its content hash -> caught before the score is trusted

cases.name: exact-value scorer rejects substring and wrappers
cases.incident: INCIDENT 2026-08-20: MQAR accepted `gold in answer`, so gold 100 could pass as 1000

cases.name: GSM8K strict final-line contract
cases.incident: requalification requires the declared #### answer line; last-number fallback is diagnostic

cases.name: score-bearing benchmark hash includes gold answers
cases.incident: an edited gold answer must invalidate benchmark identity even when prompts are unchanged

cases.name: Wilson interval sanity and denominator guards
cases.incident: accuracy claims expose finite-sample uncertainty and cannot use an empty denominator

cases.name: metamorphic: reorder samples -> same aggregate
cases.incident: validate_samples must be order-independent

cases.name: metamorphic: rerun scorer -> same result
cases.incident: the code scorer must be deterministic across identical runs

cases.name: metamorphic: irrelevant metadata -> same result
cases.incident: extra non-scoring fields on a record must not change validation

cases.name: metamorphic: fresh vs cached evaluation -> same result
cases.incident: with the stale-cache bug fixed, a fresh evaluate must equal a (correctly) cached one
